title: Police commission investigator position
summary: In July 2026 the police commission rejected its working group's recommended investigator and deferred the matter, because it needs five votes to act. In August it voted 5 to 2 to accept the working group's recommendation on who to hire.

timeline.text: Motion to accept a working group's recommendation to hire a commission investigator: The commission voted to accept a working group's recommendation on who to hire as commission investigator.
The commission voted to defer the matter until its next meeting.
It was explained that the board needs five votes to take any action.
A motion to accept the group's recommendation was also defeated by a vote stated as four to one.
A motion to bring applicants two and three before the full board for questions was rejected by a vote stated as four to one.
The commission will take up the investigator matter again at its next regular meeting.
Back in open session, the chair said the commission declined to accept the group's recommendation for the investigator.
The chair said a commission group had interviewed five applicants and recommended applicant two at the last regular meeting.
The main item was an investigator position for the police commission.
The deputy chief said the commission's investigator position is waiting on the mayor's office to move it onto the department's organization chart.
